subject: Post-call: Finovo pilot — cost targets, token volumes & credit request
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@finovo.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap + ask: pilot volumes, target $/1M tokens, and credits

Hi Alicia — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap so we have the same page and can move to the pilot setup: 

Summary of what we heard from Finovo: 
- Primary use case: customer support summarization + short multi-turn clarification (avg response length ~80 tokens).
- Expected users in pilot: 30 agents, some automated routing.
- Estimated production-ish load during pilot: 0.5–1.0 million tokens/day (peak) -> roughly 15–30M tokens over a 30-day pilot.

Cost/qualification items we covered: 
- Target unit economics you mentioned on the call: target ~$900–$1,200 per 1M tokens for the pilot (to match your internal P&L).
- We discussed latency SLO: p95 generation < 800ms for the short responses; we can prioritize latency by reserving capacity.

Next asks / proposed Redwood actions: 
1) Please confirm the final target ~$ / 1M tokens you want Redwood to model for the pilot (you said $900 as an aspirational target).
2) Confirm the anticipated pilot duration (you suggested 30 days) and whether we should assume 30M tokens or the lower 15M estimate for initial capacity planning.
3) Alicia asked about a small top-up of free credits to give the team breathing room while we set up integration — please confirm desired credit amount; we typically authorize short-term credits for pilots after an internal review.

Proposed Redwood offer (pending your confirmation): 
- 30-day pilot with a $12,000 trial credit applied to the Finovo account (covers ~13.3M tokens at $900 / 1M).
- If you want the pilot sized for 30M tokens we can increase credits or recommend a low-commit Dedicated bucket; we will put a guardrail on daily burn and alerts.

I'll loop in Marissa (billing) to outline how the credit would be applied and Sean for any support/escalation SLAs. If that looks good, we can send the short credit agreement and schedule a 30-minute onboarding next week.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0131
[Attachment: pilot-scope.pdf (pdf)]

From: Alicia Ramos <alicia@finovo.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: pilot volumes, target $/1M tokens, and credits

Neha — thanks for the tidy recap. Confirming the key points from our side: 

- We want Redwood to price the pilot at an operational target of $950 / 1M tokens (middle of the range you outlined). That gets our internal stakeholders comfortable.
- Pilot duration: 30 days. For initial run we'll plan for 20M tokens (conservative), but we may spike to ~28–30M if traffic patterns are higher than expected after day 10.
- Credit request: would you be able to authorize a $15,000 trial credit to cover initial integration and the potential spike window? That amount would keep us going while we complete onboarding and avoid throttling.

Two small asks before we sign off: 
1) Can you confirm how Redwood will measure the token burn for the pilot (raw inputs+outputs, or only generated tokens)? We need the exact metric for our finance team.
2) If you approve credits, can Marissa include an explicit cap/guardrail and an alert if daily burn exceeds the modeled profile?

Appreciate it — Alicia
Alicia Ramos
Head of Product Ops, Finovo Labs
alicia@finovo.com
[Signature: Finovo Labs — 555-0199]

On Fri, Feb 20, 2026 at 3:12 PM Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Hi Alicia — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap so we have the same page...

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@finovo.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: pilot volumes, target $/1M tokens, and credits

Thanks for the fast confirmation, Alicia — really helpful. Answers inline and next steps below.

- Unit economics: we will model the pilot at $950 / 1M tokens (that will be the reference unit for the credit calculation).
- Token measurement: Redwood reports "billable tokens" = input + output tokens (we will provide the tokenization method and a sample script). I'll attach the snippet and formal definition in the credit agreement.
- Credit authorization: Per our internal guidelines, I can provision a one-time trial credit up to $15,000 with manager approval and a note in the billing record. Marissa will issue the credit as a line item and set a daily alert.

Proposed pilot credit plan (pending Marissa sign-off): 
- $15,000 trial credit applied to Finovo Labs account (covers ~15.8M billable tokens at $950 / 1M; covers the conservative 20M partially and the spike window for ~28–30M we can manage with alerts and temporary capacity).
- 30-day duration starting on onboarding date (we can start the clock on the first production request).
- Daily burn guardrail: alert at 60% and 90% of modeled daily burn; auto-notify Alicia + Neha + Marissa.

Next steps we need to close: 
1) Marissa to confirm the credit issuance mechanics and attach the short credit agreement.
2) Alicia to approve the $15,000 figure formally in reply (a one-line approval is fine).
3) Schedule 30-min onboarding (I'll propose Tue or Wed next week).

Marissa — can you confirm you can issue the credit and add the alerting config?

Best,
Neha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-trial-credit-agreement.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia@finovo.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Bcc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + ask: pilot volumes, target $/1M tokens, and credits

Alicia / Neha — looping in final billing details. Per internal approval I have authorized a one-time $15,000 trial credit for Finovo Labs (Deal DL-2026-078). Details: 

- Credit amount: $15,000 (applied as a negative invoice line; not refundable beyond normal terms).
- Unit economics reference: $950 / 1M billable tokens (input + output).
- Start/end: credit active on account from the moment we toggle the pilot flag (we'll coordinate an activation time).
- Daily guardrails: alerts at 60% and 90% of modeled daily burn (we will create PagerDuty + email), and a hard notification to Finovo billing contact if >120% spike.
- Attachments: I'm attaching the short credit agreement and the token-measurement appendix. Please review and reply with a one-line approval to accept the credit.

Alicia — confirm here that you accept the $15,000 credit and the measurement definition. Once you do I will: 1) attach the credit to the account, 2) create the alerts, 3) add a short DocuSign stub if legal needs it.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Billing & Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: redwood-trial-credit-agreement.pdf (pdf)]
